Guides developers through the end-to-end design, architecture, and deployment of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

AboutSKILL.mdFAQ

The Build MCP Server skill acts as a specialized architect for extending Claude's capabilities through the Model Context Protocol. It moves beyond simple coding by first conducting a discovery phase to determine the optimal deployment strategy—whether that's a remote HTTP server for cloud APIs, an MCPB bundle for local tools, or interactive UI widgets. By analyzing your specific use case, it recommends the best tool-design patterns and provides production-ready scaffolding for TypeScript or Python, ensuring your integrations are scalable, secure, and performant.

## Key Features

01Comprehensive framework guidance for Official TypeScript SDK and FastMCP Python

021 GitHub stars

03Support for multiple tool-design patterns like 'Search + Execute' for large API surfaces

04Best-practice implementation for OAuth 2.0, CIMD, and DCR authentication

05Native elicitation and UI widget (MCP app) integration support

06Architectural discovery to pick the right deployment model (Remote HTTP, MCPB, or stdio)

## Use Cases

01Wrapping a cloud-based SaaS API to expose tools and resources to Claude

02Building local desktop integrations that interact with the filesystem or local apps

03Developing interactive UI widgets and rich displays for the Claude Desktop environment
